mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines in the prior month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in the prior month, it signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a supply-side shock where manufacturing output falls but residential construction expands, generating inflationary pressures that depress equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines and HOUST rises, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer spending exceeding $370.5 billion (RSAFS > 370495), retail sales growth signals elevated corporate revenue expectations that drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 370495, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% in the prior month, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a shift toward non-housing consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS rises and HOUST falls, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production below 112.0 (INDPRO < 112.0), manufacturing slowdowns signal reduced economic activity that depresses corporate investment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 112.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment above 4.5% (UNRATE > 4.5) and decline in payroll employment below 137,410 thousand (PAYEMS < 137410) signals severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5 and PAYEMS < 137410, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
